feeds.title: Northern Paranormal Investigations
feeds.description: We will investigate, evaluate and explain occurrences of possible paranormal activity.We will help those who experience the unexplainable by developing a deep understanding of their situation.We will seek to resolve your issue and explain any activity clearly, concisely and logically.
